nodes.label: Stacked Honebill logo: orange gradient bee mark over outlined wordmark
nodes.rationale: Stacked lockup on a black canvas. Above is a glossy orange-to-yellow bee mark with a white outline: two short antennae, a rounded head, a horizontal ring across the body, a four-point star at the center, and two lower lobes. Below, the outlined geometric wordmark reads Honebill in the same orange-to-pale-yellow gradient with a white outer stroke.

nodes.label: Honebill
nodes.rationale: Readable wordmark under the bee mark. The letters are Honebill in a custom outlined geometric face.
